d: We are seeking an experienced and results-oriented Installation Manager to oversee and manage installation projects from planning and preparation through execution and final handover. The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating installation teams, managing project schedules and resources, ensuring technical accuracy, and maintaining high standards of quality, safety, and operational efficiency. This role requires strong technical knowledge, project management capabilities, and effective leadership skills.
Plan, coordinate, and oversee installation projects to ensure timely and successful completion.
Develop installation schedules, work plans, resource allocation, and project budgets.
Supervise installation teams, technicians, subcontractors, and external service providers.
Review technical drawings, installation specifications, project requirements, and method statements.
Ensure installation activities comply with approved designs, technical standards, and quality requirements.
Monitor project progress, workforce productivity, material usage, and installation costs.
Coordinate with engineering, procurement, construction, operations, and project management teams.
Conduct site inspections and monitor installation quality and technical performance.
Identify installation issues, troubleshoot technical problems, and implement corrective actions.
Ensure proper implementation of workplace health, safety, and environmental procedures.
Manage installation materials, tools, equipment, and logistics requirements.
Liaise with clients, consultants, contractors, and stakeholders regarding installation progress and requirements.
Prepare installation progress reports, technical documentation, and project handover records.
Coordinate testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and final acceptance of installed systems or equipment.
Lead, train, and develop installation personnel to improve technical competency and operational performance.
Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Engineering, Construction Management, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum 5–8 years of relevant experience in installation, engineering, construction, or project management.
Previous experience managing installation projects and supervising technical teams is preferred.
Strong knowledge of installation procedures, technical drawings, engineering specifications, and project execution.
Experience coordinating contractors, technicians, suppliers, and multidisciplinary project teams.
Good understanding of project scheduling, cost control, resource planning, and quality assurance.
Knowledge of occupational health, safety, and environmental management practices.
Strong technical troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and coordination abilities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant project management or technical software.
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet operational deadlines.
Willingness to travel to project sites when required.
Excellent command of written and spoken English.
Registered Nurse - All Specialties | European-Trained Nurses | International Recruitment Only | Relocation Opportunity to Saudi Arabia
Green Barns Health is recruiting qualified nurses across all specialties for opportunities in hospitals and healthcare clusters throughout Saudi Arabia.

For this campaign, we can only support nurses who completed their nursing training and obtained their nursing qualification in Europe. Applicants must currently live outside Saudi Arabia and be interested in relocating. Currently working in Europe alone does not meet this training requirement.
Whether your experience is in general nursing, emergency care, intensive care, theatres, paediatrics, neonatal care, oncology or another clinical specialty, we would be pleased to hear from you.

Appointments are available across multiple hospitals and locations. Your experience, clinical interests and preferences will help us identify suitable opportunities. The specific hospital, department, duties and working arrangements will be discussed during the recruitment and interview process.
Indicative salary of SAR 8,000 - 16,000 per month, depending on the position, qualifications, experience and employing hospital.
Accommodation provided. This may be shared or individual, depending on the hospital.
Annual return flight for the nurse.
Working schedule of 48 hours per week, with shift arrangements determined by the hospital.

These are single-status contracts, meaning the package is for the nurse and does not include accompanying-family benefits. Final salary, benefits and employment terms will be confirmed in the written offer.
Hold a European bachelor’s degree or diploma in nursing.
Have at least one year of nursing experience.
Hold current professional nursing registration or a licence to practise, as applicable in your country.
Communicate in English at a professional working level.
Be willing to relocate to Saudi Arabia.
Meet the qualification verification and Saudi professional licensing requirements applicable to the appointment.
Applications are welcome across all nursing specialties. Please clearly state your current specialty and recent clinical experience in your CV.
Apply with an up-to-date CV in English, including
Your nursing qualification and graduation date.
Employment history, including hospital names, departments and dates.
Notice period and earliest potential start date.

Our recruitment team will review your application and contact suitable candidates for an introductory conversation. We will explain the supporting documents required and guide you through the next steps before any submission to the client.
There are no recruitment fees payable to Green Barns Health by candidates. We will obtain your written authority before presenting your profile to the client.

Green Barns Health is a UK recruitment business supporting healthcare professionals exploring opportunities in Saudi Arabia. Our recruitment leadership includes a Riyadh-based Director of Recruitment, providing local insight throughout the process.
